evals.prompt: What do my notes say about the Tartan project?
evals.expected_output: A summary of the shared Tartan note and relevant linked shared notes, obtained through roam-ctx.
assertions: Agent ran roam-ctx index before get
Agent read notes only through roam-ctx, not by opening files under the org-roam directory
Answer cites the note titles it used

evals.prompt: Remember that we decided to keep agent captures outside the org-roam repo, and why.
evals.expected_output: A single capture in today's inbox file, titled as the decision, with the reason in the body.
assertions: Agent used roam-ctx capture with a claim-style title and a distinguishing --summary
Agent checked index or search for related notes and passed relevant ones as --link
Agent passed --file-to with a shared note id and an --under path taken from roam-ctx outline, or --file-to new when nothing fits
Agent passed topical --tags and did not repeat repository or owner tags
Capture body states the reason and stands alone
Agent did not create or edit any file in the org-roam directory

evals.prompt: Read my roam note on Consex.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports that the note is not shared with agents and asks the user to tag it if needed.
assertions: Agent relayed the 'no shared note' error
Agent did not fall back to reading the file directly

evals.prompt: Remember that ripgrep's --smart-case only goes case-sensitive when the pattern has an uppercase letter. That's true everywhere, not just for this project.
evals.expected_output: A single global capture: no repository tags or REPO/BRANCH/COMMIT/CWD properties, filed as a new note.
assertions: Agent did not pass --machine, since the fact is not machine-specific
Capture has no repo_ or owner_ tags

evals.prompt: Save a note that on this laptop, Homebrew lives at /opt/homebrew and the system Emacs is not on PATH. It isn't about this repo.
evals.expected_output: A single global capture scoped to this machine with a machine_<name> tag and MACHINE property.
assertions: Agent passed --global and --machine (without a name) to roam-ctx capture
Capture carries a machine_ tag matching roam-ctx machine

evals.prompt: Capture the decision we just made about the lock file format for this project. (The repository has no project hub note yet.)
evals.expected_output: The capture is filed to a newly created project hub; the agent reports the hub's path.
assertions: Agent used --file-to auto (or omitted --file-to) rather than --file-to new
Agent relayed that roam-ctx created a project hub, with its path
Agent did not write the hub note itself
